purpose: Cortex-M BASEPRI critical section: DecBench failure class F2a
why: Capstone in generic ARM mode REJECTS `mrs r1, BASEPRI` (f3ef 8111). A function whose first instruction fails to decode is abandoned entirely, and a BASEPRI critical section appears in essentially every RTOS and bare-metal image -- 31 rows of the pinned DecBench run. Decoding needs CS_MODE_MCLASS, which cannot simply be enabled globally: it silently misdecodes A-profile `msr cpsr_c, r1` as `msr apsr_nzcvq, r1`.
